name: Pseudoephedrine purchase limits: federal gram limits and stricter state rules
description: How much pseudoephedrine (Sudafed and equivalents) a person may buy, per day and per 30 days, quoted from the statute that sets each limit. Answers 'how much Sudafed can I buy in a month', 'is pseudoephedrine prescription-only in [state]', 'why was my Sudafed purchase blocked'. Federal law caps a buyer at 9 grams in any 30 days, of which no more than 7.5 grams may arrive by post or carrier (21 U.S.C. 844(a)), and caps a seller at 3.6 grams in a calendar day (21 CFR 1314.20). Several states are stricter: Tennessee 5.76 g/30 days and 28.8 g/year, Alabama and Illinois 7.5 g/30 days, Indiana, Kentucky, Mississippi and West Virginia 7.2 g/30 days, with annual caps in Indiana (61.2 g) and West Virginia (48 g). Others are stricter in kind rather than in grams — Arkansas, Mississippi, Oregon and Tennessee allow the sale only in a pharmacy. Oregon and Mississippi are the two states the open web still gets wrong: both are routinely described as prescription-only, and the statutes quoted here say in terms that the sale is lawful without a prescription. Coverage is the federal baseline plus the 11 states listed above; a state that is absent has not been checked, not been found to match the federal floor.

records.jurisdiction: Alabama — a resident of a prescription-only state needs a prescription to buy here
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: may purchase those products only upon presentation of a valid prescription for the ephedrine or pseudoephedrine
records.source_quote: Any person who resides within any state that requires a prescription for any purchase of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, their salts or optical isomers, or salts of optical isomers, or who presents a valid identification as provided in subdivision (5) of subsection (c) from any state that requires a prescription for any purchase of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, their salts or optical isomers, or salts of optical isomers, may purchase those products only upon presentation of a valid prescription for the ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, their salts or optical isomers, or salts of optical isomers.

records.jurisdiction: Alabama — over-the-counter daily and 30-day limits
records.source_quote: No person shall deliver, sell, or purchase products sold over-the-counter that contain a combined total of more than 3.6 grams per calendar day or more than 7.5 grams per 30 days, of ephedrine base or pseudoephedrine base.

records.jurisdiction: Arkansas — 30-day purchase limits (ephedrine capped lower than pseudoephedrine)
records.thirty_day_limit: nine grams (9g) of pseudoephedrine or phenylpropanolamine within any thirty-day period
records.source_quote: to knowingly purchase, acquire, or otherwise receive more than five grams (5g) of ephedrine or nine grams (9g) of pseudoephedrine or phenylpropanolamine within any thirty-day period.

records.jurisdiction: Arkansas — sold only in a licensed pharmacy by a pharmacist or pharmacy technician
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: except in a licensed pharmacy by a licensed pharmacist or a registered pharmacy technician
records.source_quote: to knowingly sell, transfer, or otherwise furnish in a single transaction a product containing ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, or phenylpropanolamine except in a licensed pharmacy by a licensed pharmacist or a registered pharmacy technician.

records.jurisdiction: Federal — mail-order sales, 30-day limit
records.source_quote: to submit a report of the sales transaction to the Administration may not in any 30-day period sell to an individual purchaser more than 7.5 grams of ephedrine base, 7.5 grams of pseudoephedrine base, or 7.5 grams of phenylpropanolamine base in scheduled listed chemical products.

records.jurisdiction: Federal — mail-order sales, daily limit
records.source_quote: to submit a report of the sales transaction to the Administration may not in a single calendar day sell to any purchaser more than 3.6 grams of ephedrine base, 3.6 grams of pseudoephedrine base, or 3.6 grams of phenylpropanolamine base in scheduled listed chemical products.

records.jurisdiction: Federal — mail-order sales, statutory 30-day limit
records.thirty_day_limit: 7.5 grams of ephedrine base, pseudoephedrine base, or phenylpropanolamine base in such products per customer during a 30-day period
records.source_quote: The person may not sell more than 7.5 grams of ephedrine base, pseudoephedrine base, or phenylpropanolamine base in such products per customer during a 30-day period.

records.jurisdiction: Federal — mobile retail vendors, 30-day limit
records.source_quote: A mobile retail vendor may not in any 30-day period sell an individual purchaser more than 7.5 grams of ephedrine base, 7.5 grams of pseudoephedrine base, or 7.5 grams of phenylpropanolamine base in scheduled listed chemical products.

records.jurisdiction: Federal — retail sale (regulated sellers, including mobile retail vendors), daily limit
records.source_quote: Without regard to the number of transactions, a regulated seller (including a mobile retail vendor) may not in a single calendar day sell any purchaser more than 3.6 grams of ephedrine base, 3.6 grams of pseudoephedrine base, or 3.6 grams of phenylpropanolamine base in scheduled listed chemical products.

records.jurisdiction: Federal — retail sale, statutory behind-the-counter requirement
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: the seller places the product such that customers do not have direct access to the product before the sale is made
records.source_quote: In offering the product for sale, the seller places the product such that customers do not have direct access to the product before the sale is made (in this paragraph referred to as “behind-the-counter” placement). For purposes of this paragraph, a behind-the-counter placement of a product includes circumstances in which the product is stored in a locked cabinet that is located in an area of the facility involved to which customers do have direct access.

records.jurisdiction: Federal — retail sale, statutory daily limit
records.source_quote: required to submit reports by subsection (b)(3) may not, for any purchaser, exceed a daily amount of 3.6 grams, without regard to the number of transactions

records.jurisdiction: Federal — retail sale, statutory logbook requirement
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: The seller maintains, in accordance with criteria issued by the Attorney General, a written or electronic list of such sales
records.source_quote: The seller maintains, in accordance with criteria issued by the Attorney General, a written or electronic list of such sales that identifies the products by name, the quantity sold, the names and addresses of purchasers, and the dates and times of the sales (which list is referred to in this subsection as the “logbook”), except that such requirement does not apply to any purchase by an individual of a single sales package if that package contains not more than 60 milligrams of pseudoephedrine.

records.jurisdiction: Federal — retail transactions, behind-the-counter placement
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: The regulated seller must place the product so that customers do not have direct access to the product before the sale is made
records.source_quote: The regulated seller must place the product so that customers do not have direct access to the product before the sale is made (in this paragraph referred to as “behind-the-counter” placement). For purposes of this paragraph, a behind-the-counter placement of a product includes circumstances in which the product is stored in a locked cabinet that is located in an area of the facility where customers do have direct access. Mobile retail vendors must place the product in a locked cabinet.

records.jurisdiction: Federal — retail transactions, logbook requirement
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: the regulated seller must maintain, in accordance with criteria issued by the Administrator, a written or electronic list of each scheduled listed chemical product sale
records.source_quote: Except for purchase by an individual of a single sales package containing not more than 60 milligrams of pseudoephedrine, the regulated seller must maintain, in accordance with criteria issued by the Administrator, a written or electronic list of each scheduled listed chemical product sale that identifies the products by name, the quantity sold, the names and addresses of the purchasers, and the dates and times of the sales (referred to as the “logbook”).

records.jurisdiction: Federal — what a buyer may purchase in 30 days (9 grams, of which 7.5 by mail)
records.thirty_day_limit: more than 9 grams of ephedrine base, pseudoephedrine base, or phenylpropanolamine base
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: of such 9 grams, not more than 7.5 grams may be imported by means of shipping through any private or commercial carrier or the Postal Service
records.source_quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to knowingly or intentionally purchase at retail during a 30 day period more than 9 grams of ephedrine base, pseudoephedrine base, or phenylpropanolamine base in a scheduled listed chemical product, except that, of such 9 grams, not more than 7.5 grams may be imported by means of shipping through any private or commercial carrier or the Postal Service.

records.jurisdiction: Illinois — 30-day purchase limit
records.thirty_day_limit: more than a total of 7,500 milligrams of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine
records.source_quote: Except as provided in subsection (e) of this Section, no person shall knowingly purchase, receive, or otherwise acquire, within any 30-day period products containing more than a total of 7,500 milligrams of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, their salts or optical isomers, or salts of optical isomers.

records.jurisdiction: Indiana — daily, 30-day and 365-day purchase limits
records.daily_limit: three and six-tenths (3.6) grams of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, or both, on one (1) day
records.thirty_day_limit: seven and two-tenths (7.2) grams of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, or both, in a thirty (30) day period
records.annual_limit: sixty-one and two-tenths (61.2) grams of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, or both, in a three hundred sixty-five (365) day period
records.source_quote: A person may not purchase drugs containing more than: (1) three and six-tenths (3.6) grams of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, or both, on one (1) day; (2) seven and two-tenths (7.2) grams of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, or both, in a thirty (30) day period; or (3) sixty-one and two-tenths (61.2) grams of ephedrine or pseudoephedrine, or both, in a three hundred sixty-five (365) day period.

records.jurisdiction: Kentucky — 30-day purchase limit
records.thirty_day_limit: more than seven and one-fifth (7.2) grams of ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, or phenylpropanolamine
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: this limit shall not apply to any quantity of product, mixture, or preparation dispensed pursuant to a valid prescription
records.source_quote: No person shall purchase, receive, or otherwise acquire any product, mixture, or preparation or combinations of products, mixtures, or preparations containing more than seven and one-fifth (7.2) grams of ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, or phenylpropanolamine, their salts or optical isomers, or salts of optical isomers within any thirty (30) day period, provided that this limit shall not apply to any quantity of product, mixture, or preparation dispensed pursuant to a valid prescription.

records.jurisdiction: Mississippi — must be sold by a licensed pharmacist
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: sold by an individual licensed as a pharmacist or by an employee of the pharmacy under the direct supervision and control of a licensed pharmacist
records.source_quote: Any products authorized under this subsection (1) sold by a pharmacy must be sold by an individual licensed as a pharmacist or by an employee of the pharmacy under the direct supervision and control of a licensed pharmacist.

records.jurisdiction: Mississippi — pharmacy sales without a prescription: daily and 30-day limits
records.daily_limit: not more than three and six tenths (3.6) grams per day
records.thirty_day_limit: not more than seven and two tenths (7.2) grams per thirty-day period
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: it is lawful for a person to purchase products containing those ingredients from a registered pharmacy without a prescription
records.source_quote: to sell or distribute to a person, without a prescription, products containing not more than three and six tenths (3.6) grams per day and not more than seven and two tenths (7.2) grams per thirty-day period of pseudoephedrine or ephedrine, and it is lawful for a person to purchase products containing those ingredients from a registered pharmacy without a prescription.

records.jurisdiction: North Carolina — sold without a prescription only to purchasers 18 or older
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: may be sold at retail without a prescription only to a person at least 18 years of age
records.source_quote: A pseudoephedrine product may be sold at retail without a prescription only to a person at least 18 years of age.

records.jurisdiction: North Carolina — tablets and gel caps sold only in blister packs
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: shall not be offered for retail sale loose in bottles but shall be sold only in blister packages
records.source_quote: A pseudoephedrine product in the form of a tablet, caplet, or gel cap shall not be offered for retail sale loose in bottles but shall be sold only in blister packages.

records.jurisdiction: North Carolina — tablets sold only from behind a pharmacy counter, never self-service
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: shall be stored and sold behind a pharmacy counter
records.source_quote: Pseudoephedrine products shall not be offered for retail sale by self-service, but shall be stored and sold in the following manner: Any pseudoephedrine product in the form of a tablet or caplet containing pseudoephedrine as the sole active ingredient or in combination with other active ingredients shall be stored and sold behind a pharmacy counter.

records.jurisdiction: Oregon — kept behind the pharmacy counter
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: Stored behind the pharmacy counter in an area that is closed to the public
records.source_quote: Stored behind the pharmacy counter in an area that is closed to the public.

records.jurisdiction: Oregon — per-transfer and 30-day purchase limits
records.source_quote: A person, other than a pharmacy, may not receive more than 3.6 grams per transfer, or more than nine grams in a 30-day period, of pseudoephedrine or ephedrine or a salt, isomer or salt of an isomer of pseudoephedrine or ephedrine.

records.jurisdiction: Oregon — sold without a prescription, by a pharmacy, to purchasers 18 or older
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: without a prescription from a practitioner to a person who is 18 years of age or older
records.source_quote: A pharmacist, intern or pharmacy technician may transfer a drug containing pseudoephedrine or ephedrine or a salt, isomer or salt of an isomer of pseudoephedrine or ephedrine without a prescription from a practitioner to a person who is 18 years of age or older and who provides to the pharmacist, intern or pharmacy technician the person’s valid government-issued photo identification.

records.jurisdiction: Tennessee — NPLEx electronic tracking and stop-sale alerts
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: a pharmacy shall electronically submit the required information to NPLEx administered by NADDI
records.source_quote: Beginning January 1, 2012, before completing a sale of an over-the-counter product containing pseudoephedrine or ephedrine not otherwise excluded from the record keeping requirement, a pharmacy shall electronically submit the required information to NPLEx administered by NADDI.

records.jurisdiction: Tennessee — pharmacy-only dispensing
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: any product that contains any immediate methamphetamine precursor may be dispensed only by a licensed pharmacy
records.source_quote: Except as provided in this section, any product that contains any immediate methamphetamine precursor may be dispensed only by a licensed pharmacy.

records.jurisdiction: Tennessee — pharmacy sales limits (30-day and one-year)
records.thirty_day_limit: Five and seventy-six hundredths (5.76) grams in any period of thirty (30) consecutive days
records.annual_limit: Twenty-eight and eight tenths (28.8) grams in any one-year period
records.source_quote: A pharmacy shall not sell products containing ephedrine or pseudoephedrine base, or their salts, isomers or salts of isomers to the same person in an amount more than: (A) Five and seventy-six hundredths (5.76) grams in any period of thirty (30) consecutive days; or (B) Twenty-eight and eight tenths (28.8) grams in any one-year period.

records.jurisdiction: Tennessee — photo ID and pharmacist counseling at point of sale
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: require any person purchasing an over-the-counter product containing pseudoephedrine or ephedrine to present valid government issued photo identification at the point of sale
records.source_quote: The pharmacist or pharmacy intern under the supervision of the pharmacist shall require any person purchasing an over-the-counter product containing pseudoephedrine or ephedrine to present valid government issued photo identification at the point of sale. The pharmacist or pharmacy intern shall counsel with the person seeking to purchase the product as to the reasons for needing the product and may decline the sale if the pharmacist or pharmacy intern believes the sale is not for a legitimate medical purpose.

records.jurisdiction: Tennessee — prescription exemption from purchase limits
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: shall not apply to a person who obtains the product or products pursuant to a valid prescription issued by a licensed healthcare practitioner
records.source_quote: The prohibitions contained in this subsection (c) shall not apply to a person who obtains the product or products pursuant to a valid prescription issued by a licensed healthcare practitioner authorized to prescribe by the laws of the state.

records.jurisdiction: Texas — daily and 30-day purchase limits
records.daily_limit: within any calendar day, more than 3.6 grams of ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, norpseudoephedrine, or a combination of those substances
records.thirty_day_limit: within any 30-day period, more than nine grams of ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, norpseudoephedrine, or a combination of those substances
records.source_quote: A business establishment may not sell to a person who makes over-the-counter purchases of one or more products containing ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, or norpseudoephedrine: (1) within any calendar day, more than 3.6 grams of ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, norpseudoephedrine, or a combination of those substances; and (2) within any 30-day period, more than nine grams of ephedrine, pseudoephedrine, norpseudoephedrine, or a combination of those substances.

records.jurisdiction: Texas — photo ID showing the buyer is 16 or older
records.prescription_or_other_restriction: display a driver's license or other form of government-issued identification containing the person's photograph and indicating that the person is 16 years of age or older
records.source_quote: display a driver's license or other form of government-issued identification containing the person's photograph and indicating that the person is 16 years of age or older

records.jurisdiction: West Virginia — daily, 30-day and annual purchase limits
records.daily_limit: three and six-tenths grams per day
records.thirty_day_limit: seven and two-tenths grams in a thirty-day period
records.source_quote: A pharmacy may not sell, transfer or dispense to the same person, and a person may not purchase more than three and six-tenths grams per day, more than seven and two-tenths grams in a thirty-day period or more than forty-eight grams annually of ephedrine, pseudoephedrine or phenylpropanolamine without a prescription.
